scope: Original citizen wardrobe matching current simulation; no added professions, items or game effects.

cases.setup: One controlled view of all 4 races x 4 appearances at a shared zoom.
expect: 16 correct race/age/sex matches
Child proportions change torso and limbs, not scale only
Racial silhouettes remain readable without labels

cases.setup: All 128 Race x Appearance x Profession inputs.
expect: 56 adult civilian combinations resolve within atlas
64 child combinations resolve child None
8 adult Guard inputs resolve safe civilian fallback
Species beyond Orc do not map to citizen wardrobe

cases.setup: 56 adult costumes in identical light/background and faction color.
expect: Visible garment cut, details or cloth patterns differ at equal faction color; a unique final outer alpha contour is not required.
Male/female share equivalent professional readability
Forester costume suits both trees and minerals

cases.setup: Age11.999,12,15.999,16; both Sex values, all races; both child labor policies.
expect: Age<16 stays child
Age16 selects adult
LightWork does not change child Profession to adult costume

cases.setup: Observe all wardrobe inputs before and after repeated render/pose selection, including paused world.
expect: RngState,Tick,NextId,Profession,Health and stock fields unchanged
Same input produces same key and pixels
No world mutation used to make an outfit fit

cases.setup: Hunter or Fight with HuntingToolLevel0, and Farmer with HuntingToolLevel1.
expect: No free spear for profession or Task
Existing spear may appear on eligible adult independently of costume
No sword/shield/armour in civilian atlas

cases.setup: BasketLevel0..3; EquipmentOrder pending; children with malformed adult equipment flags.
expect: Basket only follows completed eligible gear state
Pending craft never shows finished equipment
Children show no adult heavy gear or claimed extra capacity

cases.setup: OwnsWagon versus HasWagon; valid/invalid/dead/distant mount; saddle bags.
expect: No wagon from Merchant or Caravan task alone
No riding without actual eligible nearby mount
Gear props not duplicated in clothing pixels

cases.setup: Cargo/Harvest/CarriedFood/CarriedWood/CarriedWater empty, partial and loaded; selected resource with no cargo.
expect: Only actual held items visible
No harvest/ore from job or destination
Clothing never conceals all held-item pixels
Professional costume identity remains stable while the pose changes.
Task changes pose, not saved Profession
Travel is not rendered as active tool work
Fight remains civilian unless existing tool flag permits spear

cases.setup: All4races x4appearances x4directions with idle/walk, pause and reversals.
expect: Feet pivot stable
No clipped hair,ears,aprons or cloaks
North/back accessories layer correctly
No side mirror turning asymmetrical equipment into a duplicate
Pause freezes animation

cases.setup: Save/reload same units; construct renderer twice; advance visualization while Simulation paused.
expect: Same wardrobe selection after save/reload
Cosmetic variation uses stable inputs, never UnityEngine.Random or simulation RNG

cases.setup: Non-Merchant on an actual Caravan; Merchant without Caravan; valid ruler/ordinary citizen/master.
expect: Caravan activity does not invent permanent Merchant role
No coins/wallet depicted for barter economy
Optional office/master decorations require their actual references/properties

cases.setup: Native1000citizen view before/after wardrobe at same world/camera.
expect: No per-frame atlas generation or texture readbacks
No GameObject per clothing component
Record FPS/p99/allocations without inventing a pass threshold

cases.setup: Show controlled native views and motion to user.
expect: Technical pass kept separate from artistic choice
No claim of visual acceptance until user expresses it

examples: Human AdultMale South: None and Forester

reviewClarification.interpretation: A shared outer contour does not mean costumes look identical; internal cloth details and colors remain different. Visible costumes are required; a unique outer pixel contour per role is not required.
reviewClarification.historicalTerminologyCorrection: Earlier silhouetteCases described isolated overlay masks, not composed bodies. Historical counts and hashes remain unchanged.

hatAttachmentRevisionVerification.method: In-memory production Simulation and CitizenWardrobe compile, Color32 DTO only; no Unity invocation.
hatAttachmentRevisionVerification.api: FindHeadTop(normalizedBody) and optional Paint(..., bool isRuler=false, int headTop=-1). Brim overlaps upper two hair rows.
hatAttachmentRevisionVerification.limitation: Synthetic attachment and unchanged source data are checked; final visual fit is not implied.
